title: Thai Larb Meatballs
description: A twist on traditional Thai larb, this recipe replaces ground meat with meatballs for a fun and flavorful appetizer
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add meatballs and cook until browned on all sides.
Remove meatballs from pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add zesty Thai chili sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add Thai basil and stir to combine.
Return meatballs to the pan and toss to coat with chili sauce mixture.
If using, add larb meat and stir to combine.
Add fish sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and soy sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
If desired, add velvety coconut milk and stir to combine.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional Thai basil if desired.
Optional: Serve with steamed vegetables or rice for a more filling snack.
